facts.fact: A ministerial order of 6 November 2025 authorised Starlink Senegal to provide fixed satellite internet access for five years, per Isaac Sissokho.
Starlink's service was launched in Senegal in February 2026, per Isaac Sissokho.
Since December 2025 Sonatel has sold its own satellite internet offer with Eutelsat at 30,000 FCFA a month, the same price as Starlink's main offer, alongside Starlink.
On 7 September 2026 the Supreme Court's interim judge suspended the order authorising Starlink Senegal without annulling it; the merits are not yet judged.
